bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to veterans; appropriating money for grants to veterans programming.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; VETERANS PROGRAMMING.

$100,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $100,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of veterans affairs for a grant to the YMCA of the North to support and reinforce work in three service areas: Military and Veteran Family Retreats, Military Child BOLD and GOLD Outdoor Leadership Program, and Military and Veteran Service Program Discounts.
additions: $100,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $100,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of veterans affairs for a grant to the YMCA of the North to support and reinforce work in three service areas: Military and Veteran Family Retreats, Military Child BOLD and GOLD Outdoor Leadership Program, and Military and Veteran Service Program Discounts.
